senses.gloss: दृश् vt. 1P (pp. दृष्ट; pres. पश्यति) 1. To see, to look at, to view, to behold, R.iii.42, M.ii.54; 2. to visit, to wait upon, e.g. प्रत्युद्ययौ मुनिं द्रष्टुं ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः; 3. to see with the mind, to learn, to know, to understand, M.xii.23; 4. to inspect, to search, to investigate, to decide, Yaj.i.327, ii.305; 5. to see by divine intuition, e.g. ददर्शादौ मधुच्छंदा द्व्यधिकं यदृचां शतम्; 6. to look on while anything occurs which cannot be prevented.With उद्-, to expect, to foresee, to see in prospect, उत्पश्यामि द्रुतमपि सखे मत्प्रियार्थं यियासोः कालक्षेपं ककुभसुरभौ पर्वते पर्वते ते Megh.i.22.With सम्-, to see, to behold, to see well.

दृश् Caus. (दर्शयति-ते) 1. to show, to point out, न दिवीद्रायुधं दृष्ट्वा कस्यचिदर्शयेद्बुधः M.iv.57, R.i.47; 2. to prove, to demonstrate, Bt.xv.12; 3. to make visible, तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपम् Bg.xi.45; 4. to produce, to adduce, e.g. अत्र श्रुतिं दर्शयति; 5. (Atm.) to show oneself, to appear, e.g. दर्शयते भृत्यान् राजा स्वयमेव, or स संततं दर्शयते गतस्मयः कृताधिपत्यामिव साधु बंधुताम् Kir.i.10.With अनु-, to show, to exhibit, to make clear.With आ-, to point out, to show, उत्कलादर्शितपथः कलिंगाभिमुखो ययौ R.iv.38.With उप-, to point out, to show, to communicate to, to make acquainted with, नयविद्भिर्नवे राज्ञि सदसच्चोपदर्शितम् R.iv.10.With नि-, 1. to show, to point out, R.vi.31; 2. to treat of (in a book); 3. to prove, to demonstrate; 4. to illustrate by an example.With प्र-, 1. to show, to discover; 2. to prove, to demonstrate.With सम्-, 1. to show, to exhibit, to discover.

दृश् Pass. (दृश्यते) 1. to be seen, to become visible, to be manifested, Bt.iii.19, M.viii.152, R.iii.40; 2. to be found, to occur (as in a book), e.g. विंदतिः भाव्येऽपि दृश्यते; 3. to be regarded or considered, सामान्यप्रतिपत्तिपूर्वकमियं दारेषु दृश्या त्वया Sak.iv.
दृश् Desid. (दिदृक्षते) to wish to see, to desire to see.
दृश् (I) a. (at the end of compounds) 1. Seeing, superintending, viewing; 2. discerning, knowing; 3. looking like.
दृश् (II) f. 1. Seeing, viewing, perceiving; 2. the eye, sight, e.g. संदधे दृशमुदग्रतारकाम् R.xi.69; 3. knowledge; 4. the number ‘two.’
दृशद् f. A stone. Cf. दृषद्.
दृषद् f. 1. A rock, a large stone, a stone, R.iv.74, Megh.i.55; 2. a flat stone for grinding condiments upon.
दृशद्-वती f. name of a river in the north of India. See दृषद्वती.
दृषद्-वती f. name of a river flowing into the Sarasvatī and forming the eastern boundary of the Āryāvarta.
दृशा f. The eye.
दृशा-आकांक्ष्य n. a lotus.
दृशा-उपम n. a white lotus.
दृशान (I) m. 1. A spiritual teacher; 2. a Brāhmaṇa.
दृशान (II) n. Light, brightness.
दृशि f. 1. The eye; 2. a śāstra.
दृशि f. 1. The eye; 2. a śāstra.
दृश्य a. (f. श्या) 1. Visible; 2. to be looked at; 3. pleasing to the sight, beautiful, R.vi.31, K.S.vii.64.
दृश्य a. (f. श्या) 1. Visible; 2. to be looked at; 3. pleasing to the sight, beautiful, R.vi.31, K.S.vii.64.
दृश्वन् a. (at the end of compounds) Seeing, conversant with, विद्यानां पारदृश्वनः R.i.23, श्रुतपारदृश्वा v.24.
दृषद्-उपल n. a grind-stone for grinding condiments.
दृषदिमाषक m. a tax raised from mill-stones.
दृषद्-वत् a. stony, rocky.
दृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Seen, looked at, beheld; 2. visible, observable; 3. regarded, considered; 4. occurring, found; 5. known, learned, understood; 6. determined, decided, (pp. of दृश् q.v.)
दृष्ट (II) n. Danger from dacoits &c.
दृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Seen, looked at, beheld; 2. visible, observable; 3. regarded, considered; 4. occurring, found; 5. known, learned, understood; 6. determined, decided, (pp. of दृश् q.v.)

दृष्ट-अंत m.n. 1. an example, illustration, parable; 2. a figure of speech (in rhetoric), in which a proposition is illustrated by an example; it is minutely distinguished from उपमा and प्रतिवस्तूपमा; 3. a science; 4. death.
दृष्ट-अर्थ a. having the object or meaning obvious.
दृष्ट-कष्ट, -दुःख a. one who has experienced calamity.
दृष्ट-कष्ट, -दुःख a. one who has experienced calamity.
दृष्ट-कूट n. a riddle, an enigma.
दृष्ट-दोष a. found out to be faulty, vicious, vitiated.
दृष्ट-प्रत्यय a. of proved confidence.
दृष्ट-रजस् f. a girl arrived at puberty.
दृष्ट-व्यतिकर a. 1. one who has experienced a misfortune; 2. one who foresees evil.

दृष्टि f. 1. Seeing, viewing; 2. knowing, knowledge; 3. the eye, the faculty of seeing, the sight, दृष्टिस्तृणीकृतजगत्त्रयसत्वसारा Ut.i, सैव कुमुद्वती मे दृष्टिं न नंदयति संस्मरणीयशोभा Sak.iv., चलापांगं दृष्टिम् i., R.ii.28; 4. intellect, wisdom; 5. consideration, regard; 6. view, notion, एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य Bg.xvi.9.
दृष्टि-कृत्, -कृत n. kind of lily.
दृष्टि-कृत्, -कृत n. kind of lily.
दृष्टि-क्षेप m. a glance, a look.
दृष्टि-गुण m. a mark for archers, a target.
दृष्टि-गोचर a. within the range of sight, in sight, visible.
दृष्टि-पात m. 1. a look, a glance, बाले लीलामुकुलितममी सौंदरा दृष्टिपाताः किं क्षिप्यंते Bhartr.i.94, 11; 2. clearness of sight, K.S.iii.31.
दृष्टि-पथ m. the range of sight.
दृष्टि-पूत a. kept pure by the sight, i.e. watched that no impurity is contracted, दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत्पादम् M.vi.46.
दृष्टि-बंधु m. a firefly.
दृष्टि-मत् a. wise, a connoisseur.
दृष्टि-विक्षेप m. an oblique look, a side-glance.
दृष्टि-विद्या f. optics.
दृष्टि-विभ्रम m. a coquettish or amorous glance.
